mapper.select: SELECT p.id, p.plate_no AS plateNo, p.plate_color AS plateColor, p.confidence, p.image_url AS imageUrl, p.status, s.name AS stationName, p.station_id AS stationId, p.remark, p.is_corrected AS isCorrected, p.reserve1, p.reserve2, p.creator, p.updater, p.create_time AS createTime, p.update_time AS updateTime FROM plate_identify p LEFT JOIN station_info s ON p.station_id = s.id WHERE p.id = #{id} AND p.deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(pi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS date, COUNT(*) AS total, SUM(CASE WHEN pi.status = '识别成功' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS successNum FROM plate_identify pi WHERE pi.deleted = 0
AND pi.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND pi.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND pi.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(pi.create_time, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY date

SELECT s.name AS stationName, COUNT(*) AS count FROM plate_identify pi INNER JOIN station_info s ON pi.station_id = s.id WHERE pi.deleted = 0
AND pi.create_time >= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{startTime}) AND pi.create_time <= FROM_UNIXTIME(#{endTime})
AND pi.station_id = #{stationId}
GROUP BY pi.station_id, s.name ORDER BY count DESC
